text: I might be overthinking this, I look after an 8 month old girl and she's staying with me tonight while her parents are away. She had a temperature of 38.5 a little while ago. When I picked her up I noticed the soft bit on the top of her head looks raised, kind of puffed up rather than flat like it normally is. It's still like that now she's lying calmly. She also feels cold, her hands and feet especially, and she's been shivering on and off even though she's got a fever. I wasn't sure whether to bother you or just ring her mum in the morning.
